products.name: Seoulmandu Authentic Kimchi
products.description: Seoulmandu's flagship house recipe. Naturally fermented Napa cabbage infused with authentic Korean red pepper flakes (gochugaru), garlic, ginger, and scallions. Probiotic-packed, deeply savory, and perfectly tangy.

products.name: Bibigo Wang Mandu
products.description: Korea's #1 frozen dumpling pouch. Generously filled with juicy minced filling, tender garlic chives, tofu, and glass noodles in thin hand-folded wrappers. Ready to pan-fry, steam, or air-fry.

products.name: CJ Potato Mozzarella Corn Dog
products.description: Korea's viral street food in a retail freezer pack. Stretchy whole mozzarella cheese coated in golden diced potato cubes and sweet batter. Ready in 8 mins in an air fryer.

products.name: Yopokki Cheese Tteokbokki
products.subname: Instant Cheesy Korean Rice Cake Kit
products.description: Korea's favorite packaged instant Tteokbokki. Chewy cylindrical rice cakes paired with rich savory cheddar-mozzarella seasoning powder. Cooks in 2 mins in microwave or stovetop.

products.name: Samyang Buldak & Shin Ramyun Multipack
products.description: The undisputed kings of Korean instant ramen. Imported 5-pack bundles of world-famous Samyang 2x Spicy Hot Chicken Buldak, Nongshim Shin Ramyun, and Ottogi Jin Ramen Spicy.

products.name: Bibigo Mandu & Frozen Street Snack Pack
products.description: The ultimate Korean freezer collection: Bibigo Wang Kyoza mandu, Korean sweet-spicy chicken bites, crispy seafood pancake (Haemul Pajeon), and golden corn dogs ready at home.

products.name: Gwangcheon Premium Roasted Seaweed
products.subname: Crispy Roasted Laver Sheets & Rice Flakes
products.description: Crispy roasted Korean seaweed seasoned with pure toasted sesame oil and fine sea salt. Includes individual snack sheets and seasoned Zaban flakes for topping rice bowls and noodles.

products.name: Authentic Korean Soju Collection
products.description: Directly imported Korean bottles. Smooth distilled Chamisul Fresh, iconic Jinro Original, Chum-Churum, and sweet fruit-infused Good Day Peach Soju for Korean dining pairing.

products.name: Market O Real Brownie & Sweet Treats
products.description: Korea's most coveted confectionery. Dense, fudgy brownies crafted with real chocolate chunks, packaged alongside Maxim Mocha Gold instant coffee sticks and sweet butter biscuits.

products.name: HBAF Honey Butter Almonds & Chips
products.subname: Viral Butter Honey Nut Pouch & Snack Shelves
products.description: The viral Korean snack craze. Premium roasted almonds coated in rich sweet cream butter and wild honey. Stocked alongside Orion turtle chips, sweet corn chips, and snack pouches.

products.name: Korean Mart Pantry Starter Kit
products.description: A curated starter tote with all Korean cooking essentials: Sunchang Gochujang red chili paste, Doenjang soybean paste, toasted sesame oil, glass noodles, and dipping sauce.

products.name: Korean Instant Cup & Bowl Ramyun Wall
products.description: Instant comfort on the go. An extensive wall of authentic imported cup ramen including Yukgaejang hot bowl, Buldak Carbonara cup, Shin Ramyun Big Bowl, and Neoguri udon.

products.name: Korean Convenience Drinks & Juice
products.subname: Milkis Soda, Bong Bong Grape & Sac Sac Orange
products.description: Classic canned Korean convenience drinks: fizzy Milkis yogurt soda, Haitai Bong Bong white grape juice with real grape pulp, Sac Sac mandarin orange, and iced pouch teas.
